english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for bringing trouble, criticism, or other unwanted consequences upon yourself.

examples.english: If you keep being so rude in front of people, you'll incur a lot of criticism.
examples.traditional: 你再喺人哋面前咁串，實會惹嚟一大堆批評。
